title: Topic 9 · 社会脑与心智理论 — 神经科学
title_en: Topic 9 · The Social Brain & Theory of Mind — Neuroscience

questions.question: 对「镜像神经元」，这篇文章给出的最站得住的评价是？
options: 它就是心智化网络的核心，专门负责追踪别人脑中的信念
动作共振是真的，但它不等于读心或共情，且多半由后天联结学习形成
它只在猴子身上被发现，人类身上至今没找到任何类似系统
它是共情和语言起源的生物学基础，自闭症正是镜像系统受损所导致的
questions.explanation: 文章说镜像放电本身是真的，但真正追踪别人信念的是另一套心智化网络，脑区都不一样；镜像特性很可能是「看」和「做」总同时出现而被联结起来的。「塑造文明的细胞」和破镜假说是被证据拽回地面的那套说法。
questions.question_en: What is the most defensible assessment of mirror neurons according to this article?
options_en: They are the core of the mentalizing network, dedicated to tracking what others believe
The motor resonance is real, but it isn't mind-reading or empathy and likely arises mostly from associative learning
They were found only in monkeys, and no comparable system has ever been found in humans
They are the biological basis of empathy and language, and autism results from a damaged mirror system
questions.explanation_en: The article says mirror firing is real, but tracking others' beliefs is done by the separate mentalizing network in different regions; mirror properties likely come from seeing and doing almost always co-occurring. 'Cells that built civilization' and the broken-mirror theory are the hype the evidence pulled back down.

questions.question: 一位护士长期被病人的痛苦压得喘不过气、想要退缩。按 Tania Singer 的区分，更可持续的方向是什么？
options: 加强情绪共情，更深地体会病人正在经历的痛苦
降低认知共情，尽量少去推断病人此刻的心理状态
彻底压住所有的情绪反应，用冷漠来保护自己，免得被耗尽
从跟着一起痛，转向带暖意的关怀和想帮的劲，可以训练
questions.explanation: Singer 把情绪共情走多了的「共情性痛苦」与「慈悲」分开：共情性痛苦让人耗竭退缩，慈悲是关心和想帮，走偏奖赏与亲和的另一套回路，而且短期慈心训练就能把人推过去。出路不是冷漠，也不是更深地一起痛。
questions.question_en: A nurse feels crushed by patients' suffering and wants to withdraw. By Tania Singer's distinction, what is the more sustainable direction?
options_en: Deepen affective empathy and feel patients' pain even more fully
Dial down cognitive empathy and try not to infer patients' mental states
Suppress emotional responses entirely and use detachment as protection
Shift from hurting along with them to warm concern and an urge to help — which can be trained
questions.explanation_en: Singer separates empathic distress, which comes from too much feeling-with and leads to burnout and withdrawal, from compassion — concern and an urge to help, running on a different reward- and affiliation-related route — and short compassion training can move people toward it. The answer is neither coldness nor deeper shared pain.

questions.question: 一个人独处发呆时，脑子常自动回放对话、揣摩别人那句话什么意思。这与文中哪个发现最相符？
options: 镜像神经元在静息时会自发重放之前看到过的别人的动作
语言网络在静息时会不停运转，生成大量内心独白
前脑岛和前扣带在没有任务时会持续模拟自己的疼痛
读心用的心智化网络与静息时最活跃的默认模式网络高度重叠
questions.explanation: 文章指出心智化网络和发呆时最活跃的默认模式网络高度重叠，所以大脑一闲下来默认就在想人，社交推理更像大脑的底噪。另外几项把镜像系统、疼痛区或语言网络安到了这件事上，文中没有这样的说法。
questions.question_en: When someone sits idle, their mind often replays conversations and puzzles over what others meant. Which finding in the article fits this best?
options_en: Mirror neurons spontaneously replay others' observed actions during rest
The language network keeps running at rest, generating lots of inner speech
The anterior insula and cingulate keep simulating one's own pain when idle
The mentalizing network heavily overlaps the default mode network active at rest
questions.explanation_en: The article notes that the mentalizing network largely overlaps the default mode network most active when we zone out, so an idle brain defaults to thinking about people — social reasoning is the background hum. The other options attach this to the mirror system, pain regions or language network, which the article doesn't claim.
